content.comment_body: I am experiencing the same problem. How did you resolve it? I prefer to handle it myself without needing assistance each time. Also, I need an output from my counter. Why is there no output available?

Hello, In [product_name], signals require both a starting point and an endpoint. Without a complete signal path, the program cannot be downloaded to the device. Possible starting points include inputs and various analog or digital sources. Endpoints can be outputs, flags, connectors, or other signal destinations. By default, signals aren't automatically completed since it's unclear where each signal should be directed. If this situation occurs in your project, you can press F2 to access the status window, which will display any missing elements. The status window also indicates whether your program can run based on the current setup. Hope this information is useful.
This is discussed elsewhere. Additional details can be found in the related thread: There are no outputs on the counters when added to logic. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are finding that counter blocks in [product_name] do not present outputs when integrated into their logic, which causes uncertainty about signal path completion and program download eligibility. The UI lacks clarity and guidance on how to properly finish signal chains, making configuration difficult and leading to confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect counter blocks in the software to allow straightforward output configuration. They also want clearer, more accessible guidance on how to properly complete signal connections, so they can download and operate their programs without issues.
